puzzle.comment: Normal sudoku rules apply on the inner grid. Numbered Rooms. Each outside clue reads inward along its line. The first cell holds an index k; the clue equals the digit in the k-th cell of that line. An index past the end of the line is illegal. Blank clues must be deduced.

components.name: NumberedRoomsComponent

backend.code:
const { width: W, height: H } = helpers.cellIds
const corners = [0, W - 1, W * (H - 1), W * H - 1]
puzzle.addConstraintComponent(new PredefinedCandidatesComponent(
  'the frame corners', SudokuDigitSet.from([helpers.digits.minDigit]), corners))

constraints.name: White Lines (to hide outside cell borders)
